input: Reserve a weekend pottery retreat out of town

gold.taskTitle: Reserve a Weekend Pottery Retreat Out of Town
gold.taskDescription: Find and book a weekend pottery retreat at an out-of-town venue, covering all logistics needed to secure the spot.

questions.title: Which weekend dates are you targeting for this retreat?
questions.description: Identify the specific weekend or range of weekends the user is considering.

questions.title: How far from home are you willing to travel?
questions.description: Determine the acceptable travel radius or region for the out-of-town destination.

questions.title: Is this retreat just for you or a group?
questions.description: Clarify the number of attendees to filter solo versus group retreat options.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the entire retreat?
questions.description: Establish a budget ceiling covering tuition, lodging, meals, and travel.

questions.title: Do you need lodging included or arranged separately?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants an all-inclusive retreat or will book accommodation independently.

questions.title: What skill level of pottery instruction are you looking for?
questions.description: Identify whether the user is a complete beginner, intermediate, or advanced practitioner to match the right program.

questions.title: Are there specific pottery techniques you want to focus on?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preference such as wheel throwing, hand-building, glazing, or no preference at all.
